ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in the parallelogram $ABCD$, $BD$ is the diagonal, and point $O$ is the midpoint of $BD$. It is also given that $AD\parallel EO$ and $OF\parallel AB$. The perimeter of quadrilateral $BEOF$ is 10. What is the perimeter of the parallelogram $ABCD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since quadrilateral $ABCD$ is a parallelogram,\\
it follows that $AD \parallel BC$,\\
and since point $O$ is the midpoint of $BD$, and $AD \parallel EO$, $OF \parallel AB$,\\
it follows that $OE$, $OF$ are respectively the midsegments of triangle $ABD$, triangle $BCD$, with $BC \parallel EO$,\\
thus, quadrilateral $OEBF$ is a parallelogram, with $AD=2OE$, $CD=2OF$, $OE=BF$, $OF=BE$,\\
and since the perimeter of the quadrilateral $OEBF$ is $10$,\\
we have $OE+BE+BF+OF=10$,\\
therefore, $OE+OF=5$,\\
and since quadrilateral $ABCD$ is a parallelogram,\\
it follows that $AB=CD$, $AD=BC$,\\
therefore, the perimeter of the quadrilateral $ABCD$ is $AB+BC+AD+CD=2(AD+CD)=4(OE+OF)=\boxed{20}$.

method.method_draft: Use midpoint theorems in two triangles. First read the figure as a parallelogram ABCD with B at lower left, A upper left, C lower right, D upper right, diagonal BD drawn, O on BD, E on side AB, and F on side BC. From the text, O is the midpoint of BD, AD is parallel to EO, OF is parallel to AB, and perimeter of BEOF is 10. In triangle ABD, since O is the midpoint of BD and EO is parallel to AD, E is the midpoint of AB and OE = AD/2. In triangle BCD, since O is the midpoint of BD and OF is parallel to CD because OF ∥ AB and AB ∥ CD, F is the midpoint of BC and OF = CD/2. Thus BE = AB/2 and BF = BC/2. Add the four sides of BEOF: BE + EO + OF + FB = AB/2 + AD/2 + CD/2 + BC/2. Since ABCD is a parallelogram, AB = CD and AD = BC, so this sum equals AB + AD = 10. Therefore the perimeter of ABCD is 2(AB + AD) = 20.

solver_metadata.cot_raw: 先描述图像：图中是一个平行四边形 ABCD，B 在左下，A 在左上，C 在右下，D 在右上；BD 是从 B 到 D 的对角线，O 位于 BD 上。点 E 在边 AB 上，点 F 在边 BC 上；图中 EO 与 AD 方向一致，OF 与 AB 方向一致。再推理：按向量法，令 B 为原点，设向量 BA = u，向量 BC = v，则 A = u，C = v，D = u + v。因为 O 是 BD 的中点，所以 O = (u + v)/2。过 O 作与 AD 平行的线，而 AD 的方向是 v，该线与 AB 相交于 E，因此 E = u/2，且 EO = |v|/2。过 O 作与 AB 平行的线，而 AB 的方向是 u，该线与 BC 相交于 F，因此 F = v/2，且 OF = |u|/2。同时 BE = |u|/2，FB = |v|/2。所以四边形 BEOF 的周长为 BE + EO + OF + FB = |u|/2 + |v|/2 + |u|/2 + |v|/2 = |u| + |v|。已知其周长为 10，因此 |u| + |v| = 10。平行四边形 ABCD 的周长为 2(|u| + |v|) = 20。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, in the parallelogram $ABCD$, $BD$ is the diagonal, and point $O$ is the midpoint of $BD$. It is also given that $AD\parallel EO$ and $OF\parallel AB$. The perimeter of quadrilateral $BEOF$ is 10. What is the perimeter of the parallelogram $ABCD$?
raw_record.answer:
\textbf{Solution:} Since quadrilateral $ABCD$ is a parallelogram,
it follows that $AD \parallel BC$,
and since point $O$ is the midpoint of $BD$, and $AD \parallel EO$, $OF \parallel AB$,
it follows that $OE$, $OF$ are respectively the midsegments of triangle $ABD$, triangle $BCD$, with $BC \parallel EO$,
thus, quadrilateral $OEBF$ is a parallelogram, with $AD=2OE$, $CD=2OF$, $OE=BF$, $OF=BE$,
and since the perimeter of the quadrilateral $OEBF$ is $10$,
we have $OE+BE+BF+OF=10$,
therefore, $OE+OF=5$,
and since quadrilateral $ABCD$ is a parallelogram,
it follows that $AB=CD$, $AD=BC$,
therefore, the perimeter of the quadrilateral $ABCD$ is $AB+BC+AD+CD=2(AD+CD)=4(OE+OF)=\boxed{20}$.
raw_record.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a parallelogram ABCD, B is at the lower left, A is at the upper left, C is at the lower right, D is at the upper right; diagonal BD has been drawn, point O is on BD; point E is located on side AB, point F is located on side BC, and EO and OF are connected, forming quadrilateral BEOF. Reasoning: It is known that O is the midpoint of BD, and EO ∥ AD. In triangle ABD, by the midpoint theorem, it can be known that E is the midpoint of AB, and OE = AD/2, so BE = AB/2. Also because ABCD is a parallelogram, AB ∥ CD; it is known that OF ∥ AB, therefore OF ∥ CD. In triangle BCD, O is the midpoint of BD, OF ∥ CD, so F is the midpoint of BC, and OF = CD/2, therefore BF = BC/2. The perimeter of quadrilateral BEOF is BE + EO + OF + FB = AB/2 + AD/2 + CD/2 + BC/2. In a parallelogram AB = CD, AD = BC, so this perimeter is equal to AB + AD. It is known that the perimeter of BEOF is 10, therefore AB + AD = 10. The perimeter of parallelogram ABCD is 2(AB + AD) = 20.
